purpose: Operationalise the WPA strategic-network and 17+3 partner architecture through private prospect mapping, public-source research, prioritisation, discovery, due diligence, non-binding dialogue and benefit design while keeping public partner claims, payments, paid memberships, contracts, benefit redemption and official credential issuance fail-closed until the required evidence, permissions and institutional activation gates are satisfied.

levels.label: WPA Strategic Network / Partner Discovery Pool
levels.definition: Internal mapping of relevant people and organisations from public professional sources. Presence in the registry does not create partnership, endorsement, affiliation or obligation.

levels.label: Institutional Dialogue / Cooperation Under Exploration
levels.definition: A real enquiry, exchange of materials, expression of interest or non-binding dialogue exists, but no formal partner status has been created.

levels.label: Formal WPA Partner
levels.definition: May be used only after documented formalisation through an appropriate instrument such as an MoU, cooperation agreement, contract, letter of cooperation or other authorised act, plus WPA Human Gate approval.

public_naming_policy: A prospect, contact candidate or organisation under research must not be presented publicly as a partner, prospective partner, supporter or affiliated organisation solely because it appears in an internal registry.
Public partner naming requires evidence of formalisation and WPA Human Gate approval.
Logo use requires relevant permission before publication.
Concrete prospect records belong in a private operational registry, not in the public website or public repository.

rules: No benefit may be advertised before partner confirmation and WPA Human Gate approval.
No discount percentage or monetary value may be published while commercial activation is inactive.
Benefits must be relevant to the membership tier and WPA mission.
A benefit cannot imply accreditation, endorsement, diplomatic status or professional licence.
